title: Undertrials During the year 1999, the highest number of undertrial prisoners (44269) in various jails was reported from Uttar Pradesh. This was followed by Bihar (39449) and Madhya Pradesh (18501). The other states which also reported high number of undertrials in their custody during 1999 were Maharashtra (13960), Tamil Nadu (9289), Andhra Pradesh (8557), West Bengal (8529), Orissa (8009), Punjab (7430), Karnataka (6780), Rajasthan (6772), Haryana (6015), Gujarat (4879) and UT of Delhi (8776). Some of the States had large number of the undertrials kept in the Central Jails. The number of undertrials kept in the Central Jails of the various States were Maharashtra (8518), Bihar (8472), Madhya Pradesh (5680), Tamil Nadu (5456), Punjab (4353), Karnataka (3633), West Bengal (3261), Andhra Pradesh (3214), Rajasthan (1995), Gujarat (1748), Gujarat (1182), Uttar Pradesh (1147), and UT of Dethi (8776). The other states had either kept most of the undertrials in district jails or sub jails. Uttar Pradesh (41256), Bihar (19296), Maharashtra (5341), Madhya Pradesh (5221), Assam (4197), Haryana (3874), Orissa (3137), Rajasthan (2911), West Bengal (2582), Andhra Pradesh (2096), Gujarat (2045) and Punjab (1939) mainly accommodated the undertrials in the District jails. Bihar (11660), Madhya Pradesh (7600), Orissa (3753), Tamil Nadu (3503) and Andhra Pradesh (3139) had lodged considerable number of undertrials in the sub jails also.
